steps.en: Install the macOS app with one command
steps.zh: 一条命令装好 macOS 应用

steps.en: Register with your VideoDB API key, grant mic + screen permissions
steps.zh: 填入 VideoDB API key，授予麦克风与录屏权限

steps.en: Bundled capture binary records your mic, the call audio, and the screen
steps.zh: 内置采集二进制录下你的麦克风、对方声音与屏幕

steps.en: Streams the dual-channel live transcript (you vs them) back via WebSocket
steps.zh: 经 VideoDB 云用 WebSocket 实时回传双方分轨字幕

steps.en: When the conversation needs information, it calls your MCP tools automatically
steps.zh: 对话出现信息需求时，自动调用你配置的 MCP 工具

steps.en: End the meeting — or let the 2-hour cap stop it for you
steps.zh: 结束会议，或由 2 小时上限自动停止

steps.en: Writes overview, key points and action items into local SQLite; exports Markdown
steps.zh: 把概览、要点与行动项写进本地 SQLite，导出 Markdown

value.en: Transcript, live nudges, tool results and action items are waiting when the call ends
value.zh: 会议一结束，转写、实时提示、工具结果与行动项已自动就位

sources: README 'Quick Install' + scripts/install.sh (curl command, DMG from artifacts.videodb.io)
README 'Getting Started (Users)' (VideoDB API key, permissions, New Meeting)
README 'How It Works' (dual-channel WebSocket transcription, three-part summary)
